units.source_text: 这一行是大岛波浮港人。

en.t: This group was from Habu Port on Oshima.

units.source_text: 她们说，她们春天出岛，一直在外，天气转冷了，

en.t: They said they had left the island in spring and had been away ever since, and now the weather had turned cold,

units.source_text: 由于没做过冬准备，计划在下田待十天左右，

en.t: so because they had made no preparations for winter, they planned to stay in Shimoda for about ten days,

units.source_text: 就从伊东温泉返回岛上。

en.t: and then return to the island from Ito Hot Springs.

units.source_text: 一听说是大岛，我的诗兴就更浓了。

en.t: When I heard that they were from Oshima, my poetic feeling grew even stronger.

units.source_text: 我又望了望舞女秀美的黑发，询问了大岛的种种情况。

en.t: I looked again at the dancer's beautiful black hair and asked about all sorts of things concerning Oshima.
